title: Return & Warranty Policy
importantBody: Unused, uninstalled engineering components in their original packaging may be returned within 14 calendar days.
s14Body: Under EU and Lithuanian consumer protection law, retail buyers have 14 days from receiving the goods to withdraw from a distance contract without giving a reason.
step2: Provide your order number and the manufacturer SKU of the item
step3: Receive return confirmation and dispatch instructions
accept1: Unused, uninstalled items in undamaged original manufacturer packaging
accept2: Complete assemblies with all accessories and proof of purchase
reject1: Installed, pressurized, or mechanically damaged plumbing/heating parts (marked threads, seals, or bodies)
reject2: Custom-ordered or specially configured non-stock assemblies ordered specifically for a client project
refund1: Refunds are processed within 14 days of receiving and inspecting the returned item.
refund2: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
defectsBody: All Danfoss, IMI Hydronic, and Ferroli equipment carries official manufacturer and statutory EU warranty coverage. In case of a defect:
defect2: Attach photos of the manufacturer SKU label and the defect
defect3: We will arrange rapid replacement or refund
address: The designated return parcel locker or warehouse address is provided in your return confirmation email
odr: State Consumer Rights Protection Authority (vvtat.lt) & EU ODR platform:
